invariants.description: total water: exact solution q_tot_W = initial total + (v_in_W - v_out1_W - v_out2_W) t (the internal exchanges v_lv, v_cc, v_gl, v_gi, v_pt cancel; epithelial volumes are constant)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_tot_W - ((q_ac_W_init + q_vc_W_init + q_gi_W_init + q_pt_W_init + q_giEpi_W + q_ptEpi_W) + (v_in_W - v_out1_W - v_out2_W)*t))) <= 1e-8*(q_ac_W_init + q_vc_W_init + q_gi_W_init + q_pt_W_init + q_giEpi_W + q_ptEpi_W)

invariants.description: total sodium: exact solution q_tot_Na = initial total + (v_in_Na - v_out1_Na - v_out2_Na) t (glomerular filtration, epithelial uptake and the two NKE fluxes cancel)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_tot_Na - ((q_vc_Na_init + q_gi_Na_init + q_pt_Na_init + q_giEpi_Na_init + q_ptEpi_Na_init) + (v_in_Na - v_out1_Na - v_out2_Na)*t))) <= 1e-8*(q_vc_Na_init + q_gi_Na_init + q_pt_Na_init + q_giEpi_Na_init + q_ptEpi_Na_init)

invariants.description: concentrations c = q/V, C = 1000 c, osmotic pressures u = RT c, and the nonlinear compliance u = E (q - U)/(L - q)^2 of ac, vc and pt
invariants.expr: np.allclose(c_vc_Na, q_vc_Na/q_vc_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(c_gi_Na, q_gi_Na/q_gi_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(c_pt_Na, q_pt_Na/q_pt_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(c_giEpi_Na, q_giEpi_Na/q_giEpi_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(c_ptEpi_Na, q_ptEpi_Na/q_ptEpi_W, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(C_vc_Na, 1000*c_vc_Na, rtol=1e-12) and np.allclose(u_vc_osmotic, RT*c_vc_Na, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(u_gi_osmotic, RT*c_gi_Na, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(u_pt_osmotic, RT*c_pt_Na, rtol=1e-9) and np.allclose(u_ac_W, E_ac*(q_ac_W - U_ac_W)/(L_ac_W - q_ac_W)**2, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(u_vc_W, E_vc*(q_vc_W - U_vc_W)/(L_vc_W - q_vc_W)**2, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(u_pt_W, E_pt*(q_pt_W - U_pt_W)/(L_pt_W - q_pt_W)**2, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12)

invariants.description: flux laws: v_cc_W = k_cc_W (u_ac - u_vc), v_gl_W = k_gl_W (u_ac - u_pt), v_gi_W = k_gi_W (u_vc_osm - u_gi_osm), v_pt_W = k_pt_W (u_vc_osm - u_pt_osm), v_gl_Na = kK_gl_Na (q_vc_Na - q_pt_Na), v_gi_Na = kK_gi_Na (q_gi_Na - q_giEpi_Na), v_pt_Na = kK_pt_Na (q_pt_Na - q_ptEpi_Na), and both NKE fluxes equal their closed form
invariants.expr: np.allclose(v_cc_W, k_cc_W*(u_ac_W - u_vc_W), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_gl_W, k_gl_W*(u_ac_W - u_pt_W), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_gi_W, k_gi_W*(u_vc_osmotic - u_gi_osmotic), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_pt_W, k_pt_W*(u_vc_osmotic - u_pt_osmotic), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_gl_Na, kK_gl_Na*(q_vc_Na - q_pt_Na), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_gi_Na, kK_gi_Na*(q_gi_Na - q_giEpi_Na), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_pt_Na, kK_pt_Na*(q_pt_Na - q_ptEpi_Na), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_giEpi_NKE, 3*k_giEpi_NKE*((K_Na*c_giEpi_Na)**3*(K_K*q_vc_K/q_vc_W)**2 - (K_Na*c_vc_Na)**3*(K_K*q_giEpi_K/q_giEpi_W)**2*np.exp(2*F*u_giEpi_e/RT))/((1 + (K_Na*c_giEpi_Na)**3)*(1 + (K_Na*c_vc_Na)**3)*(1 + (K_K*q_vc_K/q_vc_W)**2)*(1 + (K_K*q_giEpi_K/q_giEpi_W)**2)), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(v_ptEpi_NKE, 3*k_ptEpi_NKE*((K_Na*c_ptEpi_Na)**3*(K_K*q_vc_K/q_vc_W)**2 - (K_Na*c_vc_Na)**3*(K_K*q_ptEpi_K/q_ptEpi_W)**2*np.exp(2*F*u_ptEpi_e/RT))/((1 + (K_Na*c_ptEpi_Na)**3)*(1 + (K_Na*c_vc_Na)**3)*(1 + (K_K*q_vc_K/q_vc_W)**2)*(1 + (K_K*q_ptEpi_K/q_ptEpi_W)**2)), rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-12)

invariants.description: volumes stay inside (0, L) for the compliant compartments and all volumes and Na amounts stay positive
invariants.expr: np.all(q_ac_W > 0) and np.all(q_ac_W < L_ac_W) and np.all(q_vc_W > 0) and np.all(q_vc_W < L_vc_W) and np.all(q_pt_W > 0) and np.all(q_pt_W < L_pt_W) and np.all(q_gi_W > 0) and np.all(q_vc_Na > 0) and np.all(q_gi_Na > 0) and np.all(q_pt_Na > 0) and np.all(q_giEpi_Na > 0) and np.all(q_ptEpi_Na > 0)

invariants.description: steady state at the run point (no heart flow v_lv_W, no water in/outflow, k_pt_W = 0): hydrostatic pressures equalise (u_ac = u_vc = u_pt) and the gut lumen is isotonic with blood (c_gi_Na = c_vc_Na); total Na drifts only by the small net outflow
invariants.expr: abs(u_ac_W[-1] - u_vc_W[-1]) < 1e-6*max(1.0, abs(u_ac_W[-1])) and abs(u_ac_W[-1] - u_pt_W[-1]) < 1e-6*max(1.0, abs(u_ac_W[-1])) and abs(c_gi_Na[-1]/c_vc_Na[-1] - 1) < 1e-4

bc_sweep.rationale: Membrane potentials span -80..0 mV and RT 289-313 K; the heart flow v_lv_W spans 0 (source placeholder) to 0.1 L/s; water and Na in/outflows span 0 to about 2x daily intake/output (2 L/day = 2.3e-5 L/s, 100 mmol/day = 1.16e-6 mol/s); k_pt_W spans 0 (source value) to 1e-3; the other rate constants span two decades around their values; initial volumes and the upper volume limits L are chosen so that every compartment starts inside (U-ish, L) (the compliance law is singular at L); every other constant is swept 0.5-2x.

baseline.reason: Candidate: whole-body responses to water or saline loading (plasma Na, blood volume and urine output time courses). Not set up: the module has no regulation of excretion (v_out1/v_out2 are constants, k_pt_W = 0), no heart flow in the proposed values, and the ac/vc parameters have no source, so it cannot reproduce such data without a physiological re-parameterisation.
